title: 2003 AMC 12B Problem 4
statement: Moe uses a mower to cut his rectangular \(90\)-foot by \(150\)-foot lawn. The swath he cuts is \(28\) inches wide, but he overlaps each cut by \(4\) inches to make sure that no grass is missed. He walks at the rate of \(5000\) feet per hour while pushing the mower. Which of the following is closest to the number of hours it will take Moe to mow his lawn?

solutions.text:
Because of the overlap, each pass adds a strip \(28 - 4 = 24\) inches \(= 2\) feet wide. So each foot Moe walks mows \(2\) square feet, that is, \(2 \cdot 5000 = 10000\) square feet per hour.

The lawn has area \(90 \cdot 150 = 13500\) square feet, so the time is \[ \frac{13500}{10000} = 1.35 \] hours.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Each pass effectively cuts a strip only \(28 - 4 = 24\) inches wide because of the overlap
A \(24\)-inch strip is \(2\) feet wide, so each foot walked mows \(2\) square feet
